HD 150706 b's orbit on the confirmed tab (P=5894 d, 861 M_E, from Boisse et al. 2012) is out of date: Xiao et al. 2023 (RAA 23, 055022; arXiv:2303.12409) fit RV + Hipparcos-Gaia astrometry and find a wider orbit, P ~36 yr (+26/-11 yr per their table as summarised on Wikipedia), a ~11.5 AU, true mass ~2.4 MJup. exoplanet.eu (EPN TAP) carries P=13140 d, mass 2.43 MJup.
